rows.en: We have not yet identified the refugee ship carrying the E2.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: However, information from Kahns has confirmed that the refugee fleet is unmanned.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: Destroy every ship in the <mk(-62.5,-75,3,0)><ar(0,3,0,50)>refugee fleet before it plunges into Earth.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: This is neither an order nor a mission. I believe it is the hope of every one of us.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: ...That battle was broadcast all over Earth, and I'm about to be held responsible.
rows.speaker: Relena Peacecraft

rows.en: The hard-liners who carry on Duke Dermail's will won't let this chance slip by.
rows.speaker: Relena Peacecraft

rows.en: As long as people do not know the E2 exists, I will be driven from my current position.
rows.speaker: Relena Peacecraft

rows.en: But before that happens, I have a request.
rows.speaker: Relena Peacecraft

rows.en: The E2 will surely bring disaster upon humanity. Please pursue Char and destroy the E2.
rows.speaker: Relena Peacecraft

rows.en: In doing so, you may lose your home to return to, and your chance to clear your names.
rows.speaker: Relena Peacecraft

rows.en: Why did something like this happen...? Is peace nothing more than an ideal?
rows.speaker: Relena Peacecraft
